metadata.title: Sun-Drenched Summer Portrait with Graphic Mark

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, sun-saturated portrait of a woman with long blonde hair looking over her shoulder against a solid, vibrant blue sky. The composition features a distinctive dark red lipstick kiss mark on her shoulder, serving as a graphic focal point against bronzed, glowing skin.
coreVisualRelationships: Complementary contrast between the warm golden skin tones and the cool cobalt blue background
Triangular relationship between the subject's eyes, the lipstick mark, and the curve of the hair
Hard-edged shadows defining the facial structure against soft, diffused highlights on the shoulder
coreInvariants: Vivid cobalt blue sky background without clouds
Subject in a three-quarter back view looking toward the camera
Single dark red lipstick mark on the upper shoulder blade

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered vertically, occupying the lower two-thirds of the frame with hair flowing to the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark red lipstick mark on the shoulder acts as the primary visual anchor due to its high value contrast against the skin.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the lipstick mark, moves up the curve of the shoulder to the face, and follows the gaze back to the viewer.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Large areas of flat blue sky in the upper corners provide breathing room for potential typography.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation across all channels; high-key lighting with deep, warm shadows.
paletteRestrictions: Maintain pure blue without green or purple shifts

graphicDevices: Lipstick kiss mark as a graphic icon

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of a woman with long blonde hair and bangs, looking over her shoulder against a solid cobalt blue sky. Use hard, direct sunlight to create high-contrast highlights on the skin and hair. The skin should have a bronzed, dewy finish.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a realistic dark red lipstick kiss mark texture to the upper shoulder blade, ensuring it follows the skin's contour and lighting.

verificationChecks: Is the background a solid, vibrant blue?
Is the lipstick mark clearly visible on the shoulder?
Does the lighting feel like direct, intense sunlight?

mustAchieve: Clean separation between subject and background

postGenerationChecks: Check for natural hair flow and texture
Ensure the lipstick mark looks like a physical stamp on the skin
Verify the blue background is uniform and saturated
Confirm the shadow on the face is sharp and intentional
recipe.reuseFormula: High-contrast summer portrait + [Subject Description] + Cobalt Blue Sky + Graphic Lipstick Mark on Shoulder.
